verdict.rationale: Motion documents its own recurring scheduling: users can create daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly tasks, and Motion blocks calendar time for them on a regular basis. These are recurring human tasks, not automated jobs or workflows that run on a schedule. The AI Workflow Builder is documented only as building workflows from SOPs, with no recurring trigger mentioned. Missing for 10: scheduled or cron-style execution of automated jobs or workflows, recurring triggers for Workflow Builder workflows, API support for recurrence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Create daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly tasks and Motion's AI Task Manager will block time on your calendar regularly so you get them done on time.
